query: Can someone guide me on how to inform the PWD about a canal break?
reference_answer:
Reporting Canal Breaches to PWD:
To report a canal breach, contact the nearest PWD office or call the PWD helpline immediately. Provide details of the breach, location, and your contact information. You can also report online through the PWD website or mobile app.
answer: To inform the Public Works Department (PWD) about a canal break, contact their hotline or visit their website for reporting. Include details like location and extent of damage. [Document 1]
